messages:
zoe: started canary v2.7.1 at 02:14 UTC, embed-apac route flipped to modelx:quant-shadow in apac-southeast1
deploy-bot: Canary 0%->100% in 7m. details: https://deploys.redwood.internal/6321112223 :robot_face:
mike: quick heads up 1 1 saw apac-southeast1 synth prefill p95 jump 80ms -> 380ms at +2m. user-facing errors none but tail latency visible.
sre-oncall: runbook: if synth p95 >300ms for >90s and kv-miss delta >10%, regional pin is recommended.
zoe: checking kv-miss heatmap now... spike shows +14%.
smoke-bot: scheduled rerun of embed-kv-prefill in apac-southeast1. ETA ~40s.
smoke-bot: rerun results: pre-pin p95 378ms, kv-miss +14%; post-pin p95 110ms, kv-miss +1% :white_check_mark:
zoe: applying regional pinback to modelx:fp16 for apac-southeast1: `rdctl routes pin --route embed-apac --region apac-southeast1 --variant modelx:fp16 --reason "postdeploy synth prefill tail spike"`
deploy-bot: Route config patched; rollout id r-2026-12-05-6321.
sre-oncall: holding global rollout for 20m observation window per runbook. please add a short release note and open a tracker issue for quant-shadow warmup ordering.
mike: adding release note: "v2.7.1: temporarily pinned embed-apac in apac-southeast1 to fp16 after synthetic prefill latency spike during canary; investigating quant-shadow warmup priority."
zoe: filed ticket PERF-3141 with traces and smoke output. will monitor for 30m then close thread if stable. :thumbsup:
